description_en: Removes specified authorized users from a shared cloud computer. Removed users can no longer connect to cloud computers within the shared cloud computer
description_zh: 将共享型云电脑的指定授权用户移除出去。被移除的用户将无法再连接共享型云电脑内的云电脑
kebab_example: aliyun ecd remove-user-from-desktop-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-group-id dg-2i8qxpv6t1a030000 --end-user-ids alice --desktop-group-ids dg-kadkdfaf0000 --user-ou-path example.com --user-group-name '研发组' --simple-user-group-id ug-3f6c8a2b0000 --org-id org-aliyun-wy-org-id --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveUserFromDesktopGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shared cloud computer from which to remove authorized users
parameters.help_zh: 需移除授权用户的共享型云电脑ID
parameters.name: desktop_group_id

parameters.help_en: The list of authorized users to remove
parameters.help_zh: 需移除的授权用户列表
parameters.name: end_user_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of shared cloud computer IDs
parameters.name: desktop_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The organizational unit (OU) path of the user
parameters.name: user_ou_path

parameters.help_en: The organization ID of the team
parameters.name: org_id
